title: Build manifest: one decoder build on one host
description: build_id = 'bld-' + first 16 hex of sha256(canonical JSON of {implementation, commit, snapshot_sha256, configuration, binary_sha256, libraries: sorted library sha256 list}). Source traceability is not a promise of byte-identical compiler output: two builds of one source can have different binary digests and build ids.

binary_path.description: The executable that the harness invokes, relative to the work directory.

libraries.description: Project-built dynamic decoder libraries, paths relative to the work directory.

version_output.description: Raw `--version` output. Never release proof and never a label.

environment.description: Only the allow-listed build variables that were set.
